Compares a numeric field of each item with a value and routes the item to true or false.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.if` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `true`, `false` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field (`field`) | text | yes |  | Item field to compare, e.g. bestBid. |
| Operator (`operator`) | text | no | `gt` | One of `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `eq`, `neq`. |
| Value (`value`) | number | yes |  |  |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
